serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
But there is something I need to set straight first.
Last time Mrs. Fisher left me with no supervision to buy some discounted goods…
How cold is that woman?! I could've died, gotten robbed and like a thousand other bad things! 
I need to speak with her. Without any reassurances that it will never happen again I don't think it's safe to continue…
You: Listen, Mrs. Fisher…
#mrsfisher.Eyes.Normal+mrsfisher.Mouth.Grin
Mrs. Fisher: Oh, it's you! Wanna see my new lures?!
You: Actually, I wanted to talk-
Mrs. Fisher: I got so many new ones, look at this one! That fly has that nice yellow color and these big googly eyes! I doubt it will be any good for salmon, but it should be fun to try!
Mrs. Fisher: And this one! This rainbow weighted leech lure! It's a little over the top so it's either gonna work very well or not at all!
#mrsfisher.Face.Normal
Mrs. Fisher: Anyway, what did you want to talk about?
You: Uh…
I don't have the heart to break her good mood like that…
#mrsfisher.Eyes.Normal+mrsfisher.Mouth.Grin
You: Great lures! Be sure to give me some recommendations when you are done testing them out!
#mrsfisher.Eyes.GrinClosed+mrsfisher.Mouth.Grin
Mrs. Fisher: Of course! You can count on me!
#mrsfisher.Face.Normal
